messages:
ana: Customer reported duplicate token lines when a streaming request invoked a tool_call and the router downgraded the model mid-stream. They see a provisional write for model A and a confirmed write for model B under same session.

meera: Can you paste the minimal request & trace id?

ana: Trace: trace-rrr-77. Minimal payload: { model: redwood-large, stream: true, tool_call: {name: search}, fallbacks: [redwood-small-quant] }

jonathan: Sounds like attribution key includes model_tag so a model swap creates a new ledger key even if session id is preserved.

devon: What are options? Prevent swap mid-stream when tool_call is present, or reconcile ledger rows later.

meera: Short-term: router feature-flag to enforce model affinity across tool_call boundaries and reconnect grace window. Medium-term: add a session_segment_id to attribute across swaps. Reconciler can collapse existing duplicates.

jonathan: Reconciler sketch: scan recent provisional rows for same session with overlapping window and a confirmed counterpart; create a merged confirmed row, mark provisonals migrated (migrated_by tag) so job is idempotent. For invoiced windows create credit instead of rewrite.

devon: UX: console should collapse merged rows and show reason "merged due to routing fallback during request" with links to reconcile audit.

billing-bot: scheduled job -> reconciler-scan/6100001200 (auto)

ana: Action items: meera -> router flag + canary; jonathan -> reconciler prototype; devon -> console note & invoice guard; ana -> collect repro and validate post-reconcile.

meera: I'll push the small router guard today and enable internal canary.

jonathan: Starting prototype now, will post doc.

devon: I'll draft the console copy and wireframe.

ana: thanks all, will follow up with customer once canary is live.
